intent: Implement all 17 approved UI audit fixes with reliable Elastic setup and datetime ranges; preserve saved searches, bounded fetching, virtualization and credential-vault storage.

findings.suggested_fix: Stage tabs for removed sources with the connection settings, perform one SaveAsync with rollback of both on failure, then dispose removed tabs after the successful save.
findings.title: Removing a source can fail after committing its settings
findings.why_it_matters: When a saved source is removed, the new connection is persisted first, then CloseFileAsync closes its open tab and saves again. If that second write fails, the save command reports failure even though the connection change is already on disk and the tab is already disposed; retrying does not restore the prior state. Include tab removal in the first persisted snapshot and dispose the old tailers only after that write succeeds.
findings.validation_reason: In reviewed a54597d, saving a connection that omits an open source commits settings through AppState.cs:90 and :891 before the newly added reload calls CloseFileAsync at :135, which removes and disposes that tab at :526-531 then saves again at :534 outside the rollback catch, so a failing second persistence write propagates to ElasticConnectionEditorViewModel.cs:340-344 after the change is committed; incidence was not measured.

findings.suggested_fix: Increment a revision when connection inputs change; capture it before starting both requests and ignore their results and status updates when the revision differs after each await.
findings.title: Connection test can certify changed endpoints
findings.why_it_matters: If a user edits an endpoint or auth mode while a connection test is running, the setter marks the new values as not tested, but the old request can finish and set status to Connected. The UI then presents old endpoint metadata and a successful test for connection values that were never tested. Capture a connection revision at test start and discard results if it changes before completion.
findings.validation_reason: In reviewed a54597d, editing the enabled endpoint or auth controls during pending requests (SettingsPanel.axaml:411-425) executes the new Not tested setters (ElasticConnectionEditorViewModel.cs:59-94), but TestConnectionAsync unconditionally applies old results and Connected status after awaits at :247-257 or failure at :259-263 without comparing inputs, newly exposing stale certification through IsConnected at :164 and SettingsPanel.axaml:352; incidence was not measured.

implementation_units.title: 1. Reject closed-instance events
implementation_units.note: Instance identity and generation checks reject events from a closed opening.

implementation_units.title: 2. Keep selected metadata consistent
implementation_units.note: Metadata revision checks and loading validity protect selected views.

implementation_units.title: 3. Reload saved settings in open sources
implementation_units.note: Successful settings saves replace affected tailers and preserve searches and applied ranges; snapshot finding #1 covers removal failure ordering.

implementation_units.title: 4. Restore applied historical ranges
implementation_units.evidence: AppConfig, AppState, ElasticTailer; persistence and application tests
implementation_units.note: Saved historical endpoints and input zone are restored before startup; relative restart assertion remains a testing gap.

implementation_units.title: 5. Make global rules explicit
implementation_units.note: Explicit Literal/Regex modes, legacy migration and regex validation are present.

implementation_units.title: 6. Refresh metadata and prerequisites
implementation_units.note: Successful tests refresh choices and prerequisites; unresolved views cannot be saved.

implementation_units.title: 7. Show truthful connection/open status
implementation_units.note: Reachability, opening and load-failure states are exposed; snapshot finding #2 covers stale test certification.

implementation_units.title: 8. Identify distinct sources
implementation_units.note: Source identity includes applied filters and refreshes after saves.

implementation_units.title: 9. Show drafts and protect deletion
implementation_units.note: Draft save state, close choices and deletion confirmation are implemented.

implementation_units.title: 10. Make fields discoverable
implementation_units.note: Initial field choices, search, selected metadata, stable order and preview are present.

implementation_units.title: 11. Improve theme differentiation
implementation_units.note: Palette, selection, accent, focus and placeholder changes are present.

implementation_units.title: 12. Complete accessibility/keyboard flow
implementation_units.evidence: MainWindow, SettingsPanel, SearchBar, LogLineView, tab behavior; AccessibilityTests
implementation_units.note: Control names and keyboard/focus paths are represented; native assistive technology remains unverified.

implementation_units.title: 13. Inspect and copy full rows
implementation_units.note: Raw row details and copy actions use existing row state and native clipboard.

implementation_units.title: 14. Reflow narrow settings
implementation_units.note: Responsive stacking and vertical scrolling keep settings actions reachable.

implementation_units.title: 15. Explain result states and caps
implementation_units.note: Loading, failure, empty, filtered and capped results have separate messages and counts.

implementation_units.title: 16. Navigate long tabs
implementation_units.note: Bounded names, full tooltips, overflow selection and keyboard reorder are present.

implementation_units.title: 17. Update onboarding and guidance
implementation_units.note: Elastic onboarding and guidance describe the implemented controls.

requirements_completeness.note: All 17 units are represented in the captured diff. Met denotes implementation coverage; it does not certify native-only acceptance criteria or erase the two confirmed snapshot defects.

residual_risks: Headless Avalonia checks cannot verify native screen-reader announcements or real Elasticsearch behavior; the plan explicitly leaves those for native and cluster validation.
testing_gaps: RestoreElasticHistory_UsesSavedIntervalOnFirstRequest only persists fixed timestamps; the plan's relative-range-on-restart case lacks a first-request assertion using a controlled clock.

SaveElasticConnection_RestoresSecretAndSettingsWhenJsonSaveFails checks settings and vault only; an open-tab rollback case should assert its tailer, applied range, and existing rows remain usable after persistence fails.
